title: Band Tribute Booklet
summary: A typographic editorial booklet celebrating the visual identity of a selected band. The project focused on creating a cohesive publication system that translated the band's music and personality into print through hierarchy, pacing, imagery, and expressive typography.

overview.challenge: Rather than simply documenting the band, the goal was to balance readability with a strong visual atmosphere while maintaining consistency across every spread.
